title: Every Flow has a peeking mascot: Lingo on prompt writing, Prism on images, Reel and Vinyl on video
description: Fabio 2026-10-25: Storyboard's Cosmo peek (MPI-1231) widened to every Flow. While a Flow writes a prompt (Enhance, or the auto-enhance step of Generate) Lingo peeks; while it generates, the output's mascot peeks: Prism for images, Reel and Vinyl for video, Vinyl for audio. Cosmo keeps the agent's own planning.
